basics.name: Othmane Triki
basics.label: Data Analyst
basics.summary: Data Analyst at Betclic Group, promoted twice since joining in 2022 (Growth Executive, Growth Project Manager, Data Analyst). Combines deep marketing and data business knowledge: paid acquisition across Social, Display, Search and Partnerships in 10+ countries, and dashboards used by ~80 business stakeholders. Expert in Excel, now building dashboards and automations with generative AI. Seeking AI-focused roles at the intersection of marketing, data and business.

work.name: Betclic Group
highlights: Built market-value and socio-demographic dashboards used by ~80 business stakeholders and senior management
Analyzed campaign performance (ROI, CTR, conversion, LTV, cohorts) and segmented customers by age, geography, lifecycle and channel
Developed analytical datasets that turn raw data into business insights
Ran internal workshops and training on internal tools and Excel

work.name: Betclic Group
highlights: Led Growth projects across 10+ countries in Europe and Africa (France, Portugal, Poland, Italy, Switzerland, Malta, Hungary, Côte d’Ivoire, Senegal, Benin, Cameroon and more)
Managed budget allocation across acquisition channels and monitored acquisition bonus costs
Coordinated Marketing, Acquisition and Data teams (direct and cross-functional); supervised one work-study apprentice
Analyzed business performance, identified growth levers and tracked acquisition, conversion and engagement KPIs

work.name: Betclic Group
highlights: Analyzed acquisition performance across Social (Meta, Snapchat, X, Google), Display (programmatic), Digital Partnerships (affiliation, influence) and Search (Google, Apple Search Ads, Bing)
Produced weekly and monthly performance reports tracking CAC, conversion, sign-ups and user activity
Recommended channel optimizations and optimized digital marketing campaigns
